run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the longest repeated subsequence of a given input string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings and compare results with a filled implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold uses dynamic programming to compute the longest repeated subsequence
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness of its DP table construction and backtracking logic
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(n^2) to O(n) using a 1D DP array
